title: NASA Langley staff tag puzzles and hieroglyphs on Google Maps

as_told.title: Labyrinths and pyramids tagged on Google Maps at NASA Langley, later scrubbed
as_told.place_text: NASA Langley hypersonic facilities complex, Virginia

plain: Dylan Borland, a guest on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, says that people who work at buildings at NASA Langley, a NASA research center beside Langley Air Force Base in Virginia, tag puzzles, hieroglyphs, rocks and formations on Google Maps. He says he took screenshots a few years ago, including labels of labyrinths and pyramids at the hypersonic facilities complex, and that they were later scrubbed. He presents it as hidden messages left by insiders.
